content: Yɛsu kan'bilà u Yɛlusàlɛm
Mpal bàtɔ̈l ba tsütsü a Yɛlusàlɛm, tsütsü a Bɛtfagɛ anà Bɛtani, mper a mɔŋ a In'te a Ɔlive, Yɛsu kàtöm abööl uboo alɔŋki ande,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkyen u bul lanà kusà a bɛ: Pa làkàbilà bɛ uboo a la, bɛ làkàman mwan a ntsür bàfàbel naa anɛs, udu awa mbuur ŋàtàlaar anki. Làtsuuŋ wa, lan'twääl awà.
Isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn a bɛ naa: "Ntɔn nkye làkyerà bɛ abun?" Lun'fuur naa: "Mwol we anà mfun a wa, waa làgyägyä nde ayàfuur wa apà." »
Apan, ba waa bàkyen, waa bàmɛn mwan anɛ wàŋàbäm u nsà tsütsü a munàmbwo, u balàbal. Ba bàtsuuŋ wa.
Baar amwɛy bàkäl paa bafuul naa: « Ntɔn nkye làtsuuŋà bɛ mwan anɛ? »
Ba bafuur asànaa kàtɛn Yɛsu, ba waa bawɛy musyen wa.
Ba bàsyen mwan anɛ akà Yɛsu, waa bàyeel ipfɛy aba udu a wa, Yɛsu waa kàbwaay udu a wa.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyeel ipfɛy aba u mbwo, bumwɛy ibwiy a nkay bàtsüülà ba kan'ywaŋ.
Baar bàyikyeenà kusà anà baar bàyilabà bàkäl muyisà in'kwɛŋ naa: « Ɔsana! Nsaak ikäl akà mbuur ayà kikɔb a Mwol!
Nsaak ikal kà imwol kyan'yà, imwol a taaràbi David! Ɔsana kà ikal a dudu! »
Yɛsu kàkyen Yɛlusàlɛm, waa kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam. Ungö muler indiir byanswà byàkäl apà nde, taaŋ sye làkäl làŋàkyà, waa kàtoo, kàkyen Bɛtani anà Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Yɛsu kan'küül un'te a an'fige
Taaŋtyà, umpal bàtoo ba u Bɛtani, Yɛsu kàwen ngyal.
Apan waa kàtääl un'te a an'fige kàkäl anà nkay, nde kàkàler wa naa nkye nde akyàman undiir mwɛy. Wɛɛ mpal kàsin nde tsütsü, nde kàmɛn nkay mpɛl, ntɔn la làkäl anki paŋà a an'fige.
Lalan kàtɛn nde a wa naa: « Wɛy mbuur mwɛy ukɔɔn asàdyà imbɛŋ angye akà ikikye! » Alɔŋki ande waa bàwem.
Yɛsu kan'böŋ ayääl u ndwà a Nzam
Ba bàtöl Yɛlusàlɛm. Yɛsu kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàsɛmà muböŋ baar bàyäälà anà bàsöömà u ndwà a Nzam: nde kàbuum mɛsà a agyɛɛŋ a ngim anà an'kir a ayääl a nkokà,
nde kàwɛy anki akà mbuur mwɛy mulyaaŋ anà undiir u ndwà a Nzam.
Nde kàlɔɔŋà, waa kàtɛɛnà a ba naa: « Nkye bàsön anki naa: "Ndwà amɛ bàsabeelà ndwà a ngyamàkà ntɔn in'sɛŋ myanswà"? Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ ya làkyàbuul mboo a mbüüb! »
Amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàwem ba ndaa ayin, ba bàleŋà mbwo mukun'dwa. Ntɔn ba bun'weemà bɔɔmà, ntɔn an'lɔɔŋ ande màtü un'sɛŋ a baar.
Mpal làbü sisye, Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande waa bàtoo u bul a kölàköl.
Yɛsu anà un'te a an'fige wàŋàyɔm
Mpal bàkal ba mulyaaŋ u tutu, ba bàmɛn un'te a an'fige wàŋàyɔm tii kà in'swɛy awa.
Petɔlà kàyɔbà nde, laa kàtɛn nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, ler, un'te a an'fige akwà kàküül ngye kan'yɔm wanswà. »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Làkäl anà làkwikilà akà Nzam.

Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, isàkal naa mbuur kan'tɛn a mɔŋ wà naa: "Lwomà apan, kyen kàbü u ngyäl", ukɔɔn asà nkyɛɛr u mpem ande, wɛɛ nde usi làkwikilà naa ndaa kan'tɛn nde ikyer akwo, ya sye laa isàkwo ya ntɔn nde.
Lalan mɛ alàkyään naa: indiir byanswà làlɔm bɛ unsà ngyamàkà, làkäl anà làkwikilà naa bɛ bya lan'wal, bya byàbɛ.
Umpal làwà bɛ umbäär u ngyamàkà, isàkal naa bɛ làwe anà nkir a mbuur, lun'dwääl nkul, waa Taaràbɛ awà u du uyàladwääl sye nkul a ibii abɛ. [
Wɛɛ bɛ làsàkɔɔn adwääl nkul a ibii, Taaràbɛ awà u du uyàladwääl anki sye nkul a ibii abɛ. ] »
Ikɔ̈b a Yɛsu kyanfà ken?
Ba ban'yàfurà Yɛlusàlɛm. Umpal kàkäl Yɛsu muyiyoolà uboo a ndwà a Nzam, amfum a angaŋ, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà andweer bàyàsin apà nde,
waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Unsà ikɔ̈b nà akyerà ngye indiir abi? Itàkal naa nà kapɛ ikɔ̈b mukyer bya? »
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ alàsà mfuul mwɛy mpɛl, lan'fuur, waa mɛ in'yàtɛn a bɛ naa unsà ikɔ̈b nà mɛ in'kyerà indiir abi.
Nkye ndüümà a Ywan yàfü du lɛɛ akà baar? Lan'fuur! »
Ba bàyweerà ba a ba naa: « Kya bi isàtɛn naa: "U du", nde ayifuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye mpa lun'si bɛ làkwikilà?"
Wɛɛ, nkye bi itɛn naa: "Akà baar"...? - Ba bàtiinà un'sɛŋ a baar bɔɔmà, ntɔn ba banswà bàsii naa Ywan kàkäl ŋangɔɔm ndandaa. »
Lalan bàfuur ba akà Yɛsu naa: « Bi iyöb anki. » Apan Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ sye alàkyään anki unsà ikɔ̈b nà mɛ in'kyerà indiir abi. »
